'''Ramud''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. He was one of the thirty [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] promoted to the rank of Knight after the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the New Jedi Order from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and sent on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as reinforcement in the fight against the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in [[44 ABY]].
